claims.text: FactCheckNI rated this “Partly accurate. True in Ireland, but most UK cities only allow public taxis access, not private-hire cars.”
claims.note: CLAIM REVIEWED (not ours, and not about our data): “All taxis can use bus lanes in many cities in Ireland and the UK.” - attributed to Paul Maskey. Reviewed by FactCheckNI (factcheckni.org). Their rating, in their words: “Partly accurate. True in Ireland, but most UK cities only allow public taxis access, not private-hire cars.”. MATCHED BY NAME: this review was found by searching fact-checkers' databases for “Paul Maskey”, not by any identifier. Names are shared, so it may concern a different person of the same name - read the article before relying on it. Read it: https://factcheckni.org/topics/economy/are-all-taxis-allowed-in-bus-lanes/
